req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-030 requires that (1) every POST /tasks/ response carries a server-assigned integer id, (2) that id is unique across successive calls, and (3) any id supplied by the client in the request body is silently ignored. The test suite covers: EP-positive (normal create, id is integer and present), NEG (client supplies an id field – it must be ignored, not echoed), BVA (two back-to-back creates must yield strictly different ids, catching off-by-one or constant-id mutations). Additional assertions pin the exact HTTP status code (201), exact field types, and exact non-id field values to kill constant-substitution and comparison-flip mutants.

tests.name: test_auto_generated_id_is_integer_and_present
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 20 seed rows (ids 1-20)
actions: POST /tasks/ with a valid title and no id field
Inspect the response status code and body
expected: title in response matches submitted title
trace: R-TASK-030: system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_auto_generated_id_is_integer_and_present():
    payload = {"title": "Auto ID Task", "description": "desc", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] > 0
    assert body["title"] == "Auto ID Task"
    assert body["completed"] == False

test_auto_generated_id_is_integer_and_present()

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_successive_tasks_get_unique_ids():
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "First Task", "completed": False})
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Second Task", "completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(id1, int)
    assert isinstance(id2, int)
    assert id1 > 0
    assert id2 > 0
    assert id1 != id2
    assert id2 > id1

import os

from app.main import app

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_id_not_in_request_schema_and_response_has_exact_fields():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Minimal Task"})

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_three_tasks_all_have_distinct_ids():
    ids = []
    for i in range(3):
        r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": f"Task {i}", "completed": False})
        assert r.status_code == 201
        body = r.json()
        assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
        assert body["id"] > 20
        ids.append(body["id"])
    assert len(set(ids)) == 3
    assert ids[0] < ids[1] < ids[2]

test_three_tasks_all_have_distinct_ids()
